implementation.poseidon_wire_storage: checked u32 addresses; public Wire API and canonical u64 encoding unchanged

attempt_notes: Initial native test build missed a RegistryPin import; corrected before any native proof run.
run-01 produced both pair proofs, but its collector assumed a component position; run-02 audited and adopted those proofs without new GPU proving.
run-03 completed a cold nonempty merge, then rejected warm compiler allocation while preprocessing remained cached; the failed attempt and cleanup are retained.
The compact-instruction regression reproduces the former spill rejection and admits the same overlap at unchanged 1 GiB.
Final run-04/run-05/run-07 use the same newly built production static library and measured compact geometry.

run-06 returned the first pool proof, then failed a test-only reservation assertion before coordinator acceptance. The corrected harness retains job RAM and threads through CPU verification. Only that cfg(test) observer changed; production binaries, geometry and successful pairs/merges are preserved with their original provenance.
limitations: Qualification of the archived four-JoinSplit workload, with both pair orders, on one desktop RTX 5080.
The two roots reuse the same four wallet fixtures; this is not eight distinct delivered transactions.
Candidate deadlines are qualification metadata, not a production deadline or throughput result.
Complete lifetime/RSS admission, foreign allocator/driver ownership and all maintained entry points remain open.
Broader transaction types and live caches, five matched throughput pairs, 24 hours AND 150 roots, full-64/deadline/depth/size gates remain open.
Multiple GPUs, AMD/Metal and pending Apple integration remain open.
